d:
Ek chhota sa patakha kuchh hi sekend men itna bara dhamaka kaise karta hai? isse rang-birangi roshni aur tez aavaz kaise nikalti hai? aur aakhir patakhon men aisa kya hota hai, jo hava, mitti aur pani ko pradushit karne ke sath hamari sehat ko bhi nuksan pahunchata hai?
Is vidiyo men samjhie patakhon ke pichhe ka vigyan, uski kemestri aur patakhon se hone vale pradushan ki puri kahani.
Prezentar- mukund jha
Edit- sadaf khan
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
